content: Unconnected AbstractRequiredPortPrototype typed by NvDataInterface For this purpose it is possible to let the AbstractRequired- PortPrototype own an NvRequireComSpec that in turn owns a ValueSpecifi- cation in the role of initValue . It is therefore possible to provide an nvData with a reasonable value even if the corre- sponding AbstractRequiredPortPrototype remains unconnected.
